criteria.description: Verify assessment use preserves source integrity and does not silently repair ambiguity, missing figures or damaged notation.
Verify assessable items are physically and mathematically usable under their stated information and model conditions.
Verify assumption-sensitive or multiple-valid-model items preserve the valid alternatives and conditions rather than forcing one key assertion.
Verify underdetermined, defective, ambiguous or incomplete items cannot generate invalid negative learner inference.
Verify graphs, scales, vectors, figures and other physically meaningful representations remain bound to their exact source evidence.
